subject: POC kickoff plan and evaluation matrix
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@aureliahealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-05-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff plan and evaluation matrix

Jamie / Aurelia team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we lock the calendar.

Call highlights (apologies for brevity):
- Goal: Validate Redwood's inference stack for patient-facing summarization in the Aurelia patient portal (latency target & cost per 1k tokens).
- Success criteria (customer-provided): 1) 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 512-token requests, 2) F1 >= 0.82 on the sample prompt suite, 3) < $0.02 per 1k tokens using recommended batching/quantization.
- Evaluation owners: Aurelia to run functional QA and final UX acceptance; Redwood to provide baseline runs, instrumentation, and guidance.

Proposed POC timeline (please confirm):
- Kickoff: Tue May 18 or Wed May 20 (60 min) — agenda: architecture review, data/setup, test harness, success metrics.
- Week 1 (May 18–24): infra provisioning + baseline runs; Redwood provides evaluation matrix and sample prompts.
- Week 2 (May 25–31): tuning (batching, quantization) and iterative runs; weekly check-in.
- Final readout: Fri Jun 5 — results, recommendations, and next steps.

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) primary contact; Laura (Solutions Engineer) technical lead for setup and check-ins.
- Aurelia: Jamie (product) primary contact; please add the Eng lead for DevOps tasks.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), evaluation_matrix_v1.xlsx (baseline metrics).

Asks:
1) Confirm kickoff date/time preference (May 18 or May 20) and the best Zoom link to use.
2) Share names/emails for the engineers who will own the onboarding and any firewall/IP allowlist that we should request ahead of time.
3) If the success criteria above need changes, flag them now so we can incorporate into the evaluation matrix.

If I don’t hear back by EOD Tuesday I’ll go ahead and tentatively schedule May 18 at 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: We prefer starting the kickoff on Wed May 20 at 10am PT (our engineering lead is traveling May 18). That works better for the team.
- Eng owners: Please include Samir Patel (samir.patel@aureliahealth.com) and our SRE lead Priya Desai (priya.desai@aureliahealth.com) in the onboarding tasks.
- Security: I’m attaching our completed security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_completed.pdf). We’ll need Redwood’s network IP ranges and any KMS/HSM details for the private deployment path.
- Success criteria: The latency and cost targets look right; on F1 metric, we’ll want a short tolerance band (+/- 0.02) and to run against both the anonymized sample data and a small live subset.

Could you send an updated SOW that reflects the May 20 kickoff and a one-page agenda? Also, please include a link to the check-in cadence (calendar invites) and the HubSpot deal record so our procurement team can track.

Appreciate it — Jamie
Product Lead, Aurelia Health
jamie.park@aureliahealth.com
